title: Hazen's modified formula for settling velocity in the transition zone

symbols.definition: Settling velocity, cm/s (unit given in the prose on physical page 345)

applicability: Settling velocity of grit particles in the transition zone, also calculated by the Hazen's modified formula.
notes: The units for d, T and Vs are printed in the prose at the top of physical page 345: "Where d in equation (5.8) is in cm and T is the temperature in degree Centigrade and Vs in cm/s."
Equation (5.8) is also the basis stated for Table 5.6.
